props.name: onSubmit
props.description: This parameter defines the function that is executed when the form is submitted. It plays a crutial role in form handling by returning the values object, which encapsulates all the field values.

props.name: initialValues
props.description: The initialValues parameter allows you to specify the default values for the form fields.

props.name: validateOnChange
props.description: Determine whether the form should initiate validation and display errors in real-time while typing.

props.name: validateOnBlur
props.description: Determine whether the form should initiate validation and display errors when a field loses focus.
